languageModelTools.name: kanban_list_boards
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all Kanban boards (global and workspace). Returns each board's name, path and scope. Use the returned path as the 'board' argument for the other kanban tools.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_list_cards
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the columns and cards of a Kanban board, including each card's id, title, column, priority, labels, typed links, handoff count and blocked state.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

column.description: Optional column id to filter by.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_create_card
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new card on a Kanban board. The optional body supports markdown; a good card body is a brief covering files to touch, acceptance criteria and caveats.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

column.description: Column id to create the card in.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_update_card
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates a Kanban card: retitle, move to another column, change priority (empty string clears it) or replace labels.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

cardId.description: Id of the card to update.

column.description: Column id to move the card to (appended at the end).

priority.description: New priority, or empty string to clear.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_link_cards
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Adds a typed link between two cards: 'blocking' (fromCard blocks toCard; refused if it would create a dependency cycle), 'related', or 'parent' (fromCard's parent is toCard).

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

fromCard.description: Id of the card the link starts from.

toCard.description: Id of the card the link points to.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_ready_cards
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the cards that are actionable now: not in the done column (the board's last column) and not blocked by a 'blocking' link from any unfinished card. Use this to pick the next card to work on.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_add_handoff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Appends a handoff note to a card's Handoffs section so the next agent or person can resume the work. Provide findings, next steps and blockers when finishing or pausing work on a card.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

cardId.description: Id of the card to annotate.

author.description: Who is writing the note (agent or person name).

languageModelTools.name: kanban_start_coordinator
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the coordinator (DM) decomposition prompt for a parent card. Call this when asked to break a card/feature into a campaign of sub-cards, then FOLLOW the returned instructions using the other kanban tools (create sub-cards, link them, add handoffs, append the verification card).

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

cardId.description: Id of the parent card to decompose.

instructions.description: Optional extra instructions for this decomposition run.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_sync_jira
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Syncs a Jira-linked board with its Jira project: pulls new/updated issues in as cards and pushes card moves/edits back as transitions and field updates. Applies only safe, non-conflicting changes; conflicting rows are reported back for a human to resolve. Returns a JSON summary.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.

languageModelTools.name: kanban_get_card_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns everything known about a card as a resume prompt: metadata, typed links in both directions (with titles and columns), agent sessions, and the full card body including handoff notes. Call this before starting work on a card.

board.description: Board path (from kanban_list_boards) or board name.
